summary: Adaptive contextual relevance without content logging

changes.title: Personalized contextual entity order
changes.detail: Rank already-validated extraction choices using bounded category preference counts from existing encrypted BR Brain Smart Paste learning. No change to the set of eligible entities, provider precedence, expiry or explicit tap requirement.

changes.title: Learn from successful contextual actions
changes.detail: Successful link, dialer, email, Maps, calendar, parcel, formatting and selected entity actions can contribute category-only counts when personalized learning is enabled and the original safe editor still matches. No raw clipboard values, app identifiers or new storage format.
